title: When you're eating and cat stares
scene: owner eating at table, cat sitting on table staring

dialogue.text: Just trying to eat my lunch in peace...
What are you eating? Is that for me?
But I'm staring at you. That means it's mine now.
Zzz... wake me when there's tuna...
I'm going to knock this plate off the table now.

title: When you close the door, cat opens it
scene: owner closes door, cat pulls it open

dialogue.text: *opens door* What are you doing in here?
*slides in through the crack* Me too!
How did you both get in here?
We're cats. We have our ways.
Also, the bathroom is cold. I need your warmth.

title: When you're on a call and cat meows loudly

dialogue.text: Yes, I'll have the report ready by...
Sorry about that, as I was saying...

title: When you're working and cat sits on keyboard
scene: owner at laptop, cat walks across keyboard

dialogue.text: Just need to finish this email...
Hey! You just sent gibberish to my boss!
I was helping. You looked stressed.
He's making your document more readable.

title: When cat knocks things off the table
scene: cat sitting next to glass on table edge

dialogue.text: I'm just going to... *pushes glass with paw*
Do it again! Do it again!

title: When cat brings you a dead mouse
scene: cat proudly presents dead mouse to owner

dialogue.text: But I caught it just for you!
That's... very thoughtful. But please keep it.
Fine. More for me then. *eats it*
